actors.name: Bao Tran
actors.private_context: Bao runs a well-reviewed banh mi food truck. He wants to secure a regular weekend parking spot on a brewery lot. He plans to approach three brewery managers in person this Saturday. He knows that two of the breweries already host rotating food trucks, and the third never has.
